labels.look: White, mineral-themed words in every style (Bronzite, Hardness…Colorless) with tiny 'style — size' captions, paragraph pair, then a family overview list
labels.ux: All sample lines are contenteditable; sizes stated in vw
labels.learn: Caption every sample with style name and size, like a print specimen, so the page doubles as a spec sheet

labels.look: White, blue heavy caps 'SLOW DOWN (PLEA-SURE) UP' with hand-drawn arrows, circular studio credits, vertical 2020–2021
labels.learn: A pun broken across lines with arrows turns a word stack into a poster that reads in a set order

labels.variantDefinition: A big-type sentence stating script and language coverage (scripts, number of languages) instead of showing samples
labels.look: White, black condensed italic caps 'SUPPORTING LATIN / GREEK AND CYRILLIC / IN 150 LANGUAGES' staggered left and right
labels.learn: State coverage as a headline set in the font: the claim and the specimen are the same line

labels.variantDefinition: Grid of pictograms or dingbats, each cell labelled with the key that types it, so the font works as a keyboard map
labels.look: Light grey ruled grid, tiny black cursor arrows centred, key letters (q, w, e, H, V…) in cell corners
labels.learn: For a symbol font, label each glyph with its key: the table becomes the user manual

labels.variantDefinition: An auto-scrolling strip of real projects using the font, each captioned with client or project and year, enlargeable on click
labels.look: Grey band with landscape images (map, 'African American Design Nexus', 'FUTURE NOW'), small captions, colourful outlined letters behind
labels.ux: Slow autoplay marquee; zoom button enlarges each example
labels.learn: Credit real clients and years under each in-use image: social proof that the font ships in real work

labels.look: White, green bold 'ITALIC AXIS', huge red thin 'DIP' caught mid-slant, short witty paragraph
labels.ux: Animated words (Dip, Drift, Plunge, Slouch, Tilt) cycle through slant values; collapsible section
labels.learn: Animate verbs that describe the motion (dip, slouch, tilt): the word acts out what the axis does

labels.look: Black, white caps heading, prose, four captioned historic posters (Fundbüro, Orell Füssli…), big 'Otto Baumberger'
labels.learn: Show the original posters that justify a new width, so the extension reads as recovered history, not invention

labels.variantDefinition: Long-form designer essay in chapters on how the family was drawn or extended, with margin figures of work-in-progress proofs and captions
labels.look: White, pink/orange display chapter titles ('Marvin Goes On A Diet'), body column, margin proofs of early weights with captions
labels.learn: Show rejected and early masters in the margins: the false starts teach more than the finished weights

labels.variantDefinition: Each style presented as a recreated historical printed specimen page (sizes, prices, sample lines), laid out as a scattered collage of sheets
labels.look: Red field, overlapping grey specimen sheets in condensed styles with point sizes and prices, giant 'FEU', repeating sticky shop bar
labels.learn: Re-typeset a revival as its own period specimen pages: the form proves the lineage
